about: 회계 II › 계약관리 › 회계반영 — 청구예정자료(API: 계약항목 · 계약 · 일괄생성 2 × 10,000) → 회계/판매일괄반영: 거래처 줄 거래가액 20,000 · 부가세 2,000 · 합계 22,000 · 적요 항목명 → [상세] '매출 세금계산서 미청구 리스트' → 골라 [매출전표 I] 창(매출계정 제품매출 · 입금계좌 외상매출금) [저장(F8)] → 줄이 빠진다 → 매출(세금)계산서현황(계약) '매출청구서현황' 20,000 · 2,000 · 22,000 · '2026/10 계' → 회계미반영현황(계약)에 없다 → 그 전표를 지우면 회계미반영현황에 다시 나온다(2026-10-13 원본 실측: 전표 [삭제] 뒤 회계반영여부가 빈칸). 만든 자료는 끝에 지운다.

steps: js:window.__api = (m, p, b) => fetch('/api' + p, { method: m, headers: {Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'}, body: b ? js:(async()=>{const c='R'+String(Date.now()).slice(-4);const it=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-items',{code:c,name:'QA회계2-반영항목',unitPrice:10000,vatIncluded:false,billingCycle:'PERIODIC',salesAccountId:null,active:true})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('ciId',it.id);const u=(await window.__api('GET','/billing-contracts/units')).body[0];const ps=(await window.__api('GET','/partners')).body;const p=ps[ps.length-1];sessionStorage.setItem('pName',p.name);const d=new Date();const ymd=d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');sessionStorage.setItem('ym',ymd.slice(0,7));const bc=(await window.__api('POST','/billing-contracts',{contractDate:ymd,partnerId:p.id,code:null,name:'QA회계2-반영계약',billStart:ymd,billEnd:(d.getFullYear()+1)+ymd.slice(4),vatType:'세금계산서',foreignCurrency:false,employeeId:null,departmentId:null,projectId:null,remark:null,lines:[{itemId:it.id,billMonths:'01,02,03,04,05,06,07,08,09,10,11,12',quantity:2,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:null,vatAmount:null,billingUnitId:u.id,remark:null}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('bcId',bc.id);const b=(await window.__api('POST','/contract-bills',{billDate:ymd,vatType:'세금계산서',byPartner:false,lines:[{contractLineId:bc.lines[0].id,billMonth:ymd.slice(0,7),quantity:2,unitPrice:10000,supplyAmount:20000,vatAmount:2000,remark:'QA회계2'}]})).body;sessionStorage.setItem('billId',b[0].id);return b[0].totalAmount})()
